plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell METU and MUU due to downtrends and leveraged exposure.
Sell SMH as it is below its stop and in a downtrend.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, prioritizing stability. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It utilizes and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Add QQQI to 30% to prioritize income and meet the mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Sell METU and MUU due to their leveraged and high-beta nature.
Sell CRWD and SNOW to reduce high-beta single name exposure.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index for steady distributions. While prioritizing low drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
